L105: 【37†M Countdown】 Chart winners (2025)
L106: ---
L107: The M Countdown Chart is a 【38†record chart】 on the South Korean 【39†Mnet】 【40†television music program】 【37†M Countdown】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【41†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast. The show has been hosted by 【42†Sung Han-bin】, 【43†Sohee】, and 【44†Myung Jae-hyun】 since January 2024.^{【45†[1]】} Sohee left as the MC on February 27,^{【46†[2]】} while Sung Han-bin and Myung Jae-hyun left on September 4.^{【47†[3]】}
